_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

First-touch graded by the skills seat (own-lane exception; session `session_01AeA3nU1B5Q2pgxqxgUrexd`): **PROMOTED → `pm:queue`**, S (governed instruction prose). Merged with its twin: **#9787 (closed as duplicate of this card)** — the `domain:spec` seat independently filed the same principle gap the same day with two more measured instances (#9673, #9752, both sonnet-tier). Combined evidence base is now **four stalls across two seats in one day**: objectui#4314, objectui#5212 (this card), #9673, #9752 (#9787). All four share the shape: contended/queued check → agent backgrounds the wait → yields believing a notification will wake it → in this harness a stopped subagent with no live children is DONE; nothing wakes it.

Scope: one dev-side clause in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — never end your turn in a waiting/monitoring posture; a turn ends only at the terminal report or a named hard-block; wait synchronously inside the turn, or narrow the check's scope and declare the narrowing in the report (CI runs the full farm regardless). Both cards' PM resets used this wording and it worked first-resume all four times — the text is field-tested. #9787 also carries a ready clause draft; use it as input.

Note for the dispatch: #9787's claim that os-dev.md edits are fable-mandatory is not what `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` derives (no path mandate for `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`); tier is the PM's call at dispatch. Governed surface ⇒ draft PR, human merge. os-dev.md hot-file serial: queues behind #9717 (in flight), and behind #9661's larger lock-mechanization card which touches the same rule-1 region — sequence at dispatch time.

Notes for the PM beyond the machine fields:

1. **The premise falsification is the reviewable part of this card.** The adjudicated clause landed as specified, so `status` is `done` — but `premise_still_valid` is `false` because the card's diagnosis ("nothing tells an agent not to...") was wrong, and acting on it literally would have produced a fourth copy of a rule that demonstrably did not prevent the stalls it was meant to prevent. The graded scope's *other* half — narrow-and-declare — is the part with no prior art in the file, and it is what the four PM resets actually added on top of the existing text.
2. **The stalls are evidence about an incomplete ladder, not an absent prohibition.** Worth carrying into the sibling lock-mechanization card: if that card mechanizes FIFO + enforced budgets, the budget-exceeded branch needs a defined outcome other than `blocked`, or it will regenerate the same dead end. This PR's wording (narrow the scope, declare the narrowing) is the input that card must not contradict, as the claim comment anticipated.
3. No out-of-scope issues filed. The `pnpm install` flag behaviour I tripped over is adjacent to the already-queued pnpm-install trap correction card, so filing would have duplicated queued work.

**ACCEPT — with the premise falsification accepted as the delivery's core value.** PR: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/9858

- The card's premise ("nothing tells an agent not to background and yield") is **falsified with evidence**: three prohibitions predate all four measured stalls (git-blamed to 2026-08-16). A fourth restatement would have prevented nothing. What was genuinely absent — verified by the dev's zero-hit scan — was the **legal exit**: for a merely-queued check, "blocked" reads wrong and waiting has no end, so agents invented the unavailable fourth option. The fix correctly lands the exit, not another ban.
- Diff verified by this seat's own fetch (+16/−10, one file, 358/399): clean-close item 4 is now the canonical two-report turn-end contract (terminal report with honest `in_progress`, or `blocked` naming the PM-only blocker) + the declared-narrowing exit (accepted deviation; CI runs the full farm); rule 6's cut content all survives in item 4 (the notification-fires-AS-the-stop mechanism included); rule 7's ladder routes through the narrowing exit before `blocked`, referenced by section name so the sibling lock-mechanization card can rewrite that region without stranding the pointer. The four-stalls lesson is one self-contained line, no issue numbers.
- Gates: 8 derived families green with quoted verdicts at head `660e0b8`; no ablation applies (prose); no deviations.
- **Governed surface ⇒ terminal three-step**: review recorded here; the PR stays **draft, visibly awaiting the maintainer's merge**; the round report lists it under "awaiting a human merge". The re-grading note for the sibling: #9661's dispatch must treat item 4's narrowing exit as settled text to integrate with, not to restate.
